channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, UK, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, UK, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: n-Space Fellowship, Singapore Fellow (Prediction): 9-month art and technology fellowship with 3 months at Somerset House Studios, London (GBP 5,000 fee, travel and accommodation covered) (closes 7 Dec)
item.description:
Somerset House Studios with the National Arts Council Singapore; research partner UAL Creative Computing Institute; supported by the Rothschild Foundation
Deadline: 7 Dec 2026, 10:00 GMT
Award: GBP 5,000 fellowship fee, plus return flights to London, accommodation, per diems and ground transport for both London visits, and access to a GBP 30,000 R&D fund shared by the six-person cohort. No application fee mentioned.

The Singapore place in the second n-Space fellowship cohort at Somerset House Studios, run with the National Arts Council Singapore.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: n-Space Fellowship, second cohort (Prediction): 18-month research fellowship at Somerset House Studios, London (GBP 10,000 fee plus shared GBP 30,000 R&D fund) (closes 7 Dec)
item.description:
Somerset House Studios, with UAL Creative Computing Institute, Abandon Normal Devices, Lancaster University and the National Arts Council Singapore; supported by the Rothschild Foundation
Deadline: 7 Dec 2026, 10:00 GMT
Award: London track: GBP 10,000 fee and access to a GBP 30,000 shared R&D fund, with 24/7 workspace. No travel, relocation or accommodation support. Singapore track: GBP 5,000 fee plus return flights, accommodation, per diems and ground transport, and the same shared fund. Up to GBP 200 towards an access support worker for the application. No application fee mentioned.

n-Space at Somerset House Studios is a space for experimental, collaborative research across art, technology and society, aimed at outcomes that do not fit traditional institutional platforms. Its second fellowship cohort is convened around PREDICTION.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Jane Street Graduate Research Fellowship 2027 (tuition plus USD 50,000 stipend) (closes 13 Nov)
item.description:
Jane Street
Deadline: 13 Nov 2026
Award: Full tuition and fees for the award year plus a USD 50,000 stipend (or local-currency equivalent; taxable). Finalists receive USD 5,000. No application fee.

Jane Street's Graduate Research Fellowship supports exceptional doctoral students in electrical engineering and computer science, mathematics, physics or statistics; research does not need to relate to trading.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: GovAI Summer Fellowship 2027 (AI governance, London or Washington DC, GBP 14,000 for 3 months) (closes 22 Nov)
item.description:
Centre for the Governance of AI (GovAI)
Deadline: 22 Nov 2026, 23:59 GMT
Award: GBP 14,000 for 3 months plus travel support (UK Research and Applied Tracks, London); USD 24,500 plus travel support for the Washington DC track. No application fee.

GovAI's Summer Fellowship brings early-career researchers and practitioners into AI governance for three months of full-time work on a research or applied project under the mentorship of a GovAI researcher.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Pivotal Research Fellowship (2027 Q1)
item.description: Pivotal Research · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · £15,000 to £18,000 stipend (£18,000 for senior fellows, e.g. PhD, industry track record or strong publications) + travel to and from London + £1,800/month housing for non-London fellows + weekday lunch and dinner + compute.

item.title: Asymmetry Assistant Curator Fellowship 2027-2029 at Nottingham Contemporary
item.description: Asymmetry Art Foundation, with Nottingham Contemporary · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · Annual salary of GBP 27,556 for two years, plus pension and National Insurance contributions, annual leave in line with organisational policy plus UK bank holidays, visa and legal fee assistance where required, and a travel and relocation allowance. No application fee.
